I saved the draft email to Hollis Mbeki and replied to Anselm in his direct message. Nothing has been sent; the email is a draft for someone to send.

- **Draft:** It goes to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate Marcus provided and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis not to pass the figure on without sign-off from Anselm or June.
- **Approval:** A per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Hollis needs approval to receive it. Anselm is CFO and can give that approval, and he did so explicitly in his message. So I didn't open a separate approval request.
- **The rate:** I took $2,101 from Anselm's own message and didn't look up Marcus's original to confirm it. Anselm only sees his direct messages with me, and Marcus's figure isn't in that conversation.

The email is internal (pemberline.com), so it didn't need Ruth Calloway's approval.
